_doc: DayZero clean-up levels, modelled on the presets of Chris Titus Tech's WinUtil
(https://github.com/ChrisTitusTech/winutil, MIT licence): Clear, Minimal, Standard and Advanced.
The level is picked in the USB builder (separately from the mode) and pre-selected on the new PC's
review screen, where picking a level ticks its tweaks and every switch can still be changed.
levels:   in order; each level ALSO does everything the levels above it do.
tweaks   = tweak ids from tweaks.json the level adds,
removals = optionalRemovals ids the level adds.
packages: preinstalled apps removed; 'level' is the first level that removes it (wildcards allowed).
unlessApp: not removed when that app from apps.json is being installed (e.g. Teams).
Removal = removed for your account and for new accounts (deprovisioned).
Undo: 'DayZero.cmd -Undo' reinstalls each removed app from the Microsoft Store by its exact name.
keep:     never removed, whatever the lists say (the code has its own copy of the essentials,
including the Store, Calculator, Photos, App Installer/winget and Windows Security).
winutil:  how each item of WinUtil's presets maps to DayZero, including what DayZero leaves out and why.
aliases:  level names from DayZero 0.7 and earlier.

levels.title: Clear
levels.description: Windows stays exactly as Microsoft ships it: no apps removed, no privacy or clean-up tweaks.

levels.title: Minimal
levels.description: WinUtil's Minimal preset: telemetry off, background services trimmed, no promoted apps, no firmware-installed programs. Removes only the third-party promo apps (Candy Crush, TikTok, Netflix links...).

levels.title: Standard
levels.description: WinUtil's Standard preset: Minimal plus activity history, location and Delivery Optimization sharing off, 'End task' on the taskbar, generic folder views, temp files and old update files cleaned. Removes Microsoft's extras too (Clipchamp, News, Weather, Copilot, Solitaire, To Do, Get Help...).

levels.title: Advanced
levels.description: WinUtil's Advanced preset: Standard plus Copilot, Recall and Notepad AI off, Widgets off, no Bing results in Start search, the classic right-click menu, and OneDrive removed. Also removes new Outlook, preinstalled Teams, Phone Link, Movies & TV, Maps and Family Safety.

packages.name: king.com.*
packages.title: Candy Crush and other King games

packages.name: SpotifyAB.SpotifyMusic
packages.title: Spotify (Store link; the desktop app is installed separately)

optionalRemovals.title: Remove OneDrive
optionalRemovals.what: Uninstalls the OneDrive app (winget uninstall Microsoft.OneDrive). Files already in your OneDrive folder stay on this PC and online.
optionalRemovals.warning: Files that are 'online-only' stay in the cloud and stop syncing to this PC. Undo reinstalls OneDrive.

winutil.note: Without Defender's 'automatic sample submission off': DayZero never weakens Defender (its cloud 'block at first sight' needs samples).
Without disabling Internet Connection Sharing (SharedAccess): that would break Mobile hotspot.
The policy only works on Enterprise/Education; promoted-apps-off does it on Home and Pro.
Windows Update keeps working; only peer-to-peer sharing stops.

winutil.item: File Explorer Automatic Folder Discovery - Disable
winutil.note: Sets the generic folder type but does not wipe saved folder views (that could not be undone).

winutil.item: End Task With Right Click - Enable

winutil.note: DISM component clean-up without /ResetBase (updates stay uninstallable); cleanmgr is not run because it waits for a click.
DayZero always creates one before any change.
Uses the documented Recall and Notepad policies instead of WinUtil's package end-of-life trick.
Turned off by policy; the Windows Web Experience Pack (a Windows component) stays installed.
Files in your OneDrive folder stay on the PC and online.

winutil.item: Microsoft Store Recommended Search Results - Disable
winutil.note: WinUtil denies everyone access to the Store's database file; DayZero does not, and turns off Bing web results in Start search instead.
An undocumented feature flag that WinUtil itself says no longer works on current Windows.

winutil.item: Calculator, Clock, Sticky Notes, Sound Recorder, Quick Assist
winutil.note: Small built-in tools DayZero never removes.
